description: Model provider that pays each request with an x402 USDC authorization signed by a local wallet.

expectedBehaviors.purpose: wallet key (0600), local proxy token, spending ledger and cached model list
optional wallet key for x402 payment signing
expectedBehaviors.justification: The key signs EIP-3009 USDC authorizations locally. Only the signature is sent; the key never leaves the machine.

expectedBehaviors.purpose: local OpenAI-compatible proxy; requires a random bearer token and refuses browser requests
the model gateway: prompts are sent there to be answered

securityNotes: Payments are signed only for USDC on Base, only to the pinned payee, only up to maxPerCallUsd per request and maxPerDayUsd per day.
The wallet is created locally by `openclaw-model-access setup`; nothing is custodied by the plugin author.
Prompts and tool definitions are sent to the gateway and from there to the model supplier that answers.
